title: Validate semantic visual asset records and approved provenance without loading files
prompt: Read README.md, AGENTS.md, docs/SWARM_BENCHMARK.md, docs/PILOT100_READY.md, docs/PILOT100_DOMAIN_CONTRACTS.md and the task sourceRefs before editing. This is an independent leaf in the B001–B100 cohort, not an integration or completed feature claim. Implement only the owned source and tests, using the exact pinned API section in PILOT100_DOMAIN_CONTRACTS. No imports from unmerged A/B modules, no manifests/barrels/App.tsx/shared task metadata edits and no new dependencies. Locally declare the contract's shared structural types; package engine/protocol production stays ES2022-only and pure, with no Firebase, browser, Node, UI, credentials, wall clock or global randomness. Use existing deterministic engine RNG only where the contract permits. Never turn a trusted verifier input into a claim of cryptographic verification. Unspecified rules remain explicit named decision-required results; no worker invents policies. Preserve existing T01–T10 API/tests. Run scoped lint/typecheck/tests, then node tools/benchmark-pilot.mjs --profile full. Return a handoff with paths, API, actual checks, benchmark receipt references and limitations. No commits, pushes, PRs, child agents, deployment, credential access, task-issue mutation or budget changes. Implement decodeVisualAssetRecord exactly as frozen in section B094 of docs/PILOT100_DOMAIN_CONTRACTS.md. Exact own data keys as signature. semanticKey is dotted original semantic ID1–128; label/source/license are bounded nonempty text; uiPath is repository-relative under assets/ with PNG/WebP extension, no URL,backslash,dot-segment or empty component. Both SHA fields are64lowercasehex and approval digest is an attestation reference, not proof the reviewer actually approved. Decoder never downloads/generates production art.
acceptance: A valid approved-record shape decodes into a detached allowlisted record with its semantic label.
Reject unsafe paths/URLs/unsupported formats, missing approval/master digests and empty provenance.
Accessor/symbol/unknown fields fail without reads; no filesystem, art API or owner approval is fabricated.
The exported implementation matches the frozen local structural API, preserves legacy APIs, and changes only declared ownership; no unresolved rule is silently decided.

Scoped lint, typecheck and meaningful tests pass, followed by node tools/benchmark-pilot.mjs --profile full; handoff records actual outcomes and receipt references without claiming App/provider integration.
